title: Destructuring, spread, rest, and modern syntax — concept map
intro: Object and array destructuring, rest/spread in calls and literals, optional chaining combos, and readable API design.

flowchart TD
  O[Object destructure] --> S[Spread / rest]
  A[Array destructure + swap] --> S

  K --> P[Options object APIs]

conceptCards.title: Object destructuring, defaults, and renaming
conceptCards.summary: Defaults apply for undefined not null; nested destructure needs = {} on optional branches; { id: userId } rename.

conceptCards.title: Array destructuring and swap patterns
conceptCards.summary: Index-based unpack, comma holes, rest must be last, [a,b]=[b,a] swap without temp.

conceptCards.title: Spread and rest in arrays, objects, and function calls
conceptCards.summary: Spread expands; rest collects — shallow merge only; structuredClone for nested immutability.

conceptCards.title: Shorthand properties and computed property names
conceptCards.summary: { name } shorthand vs { [field]: value } computed — reducer SET_FIELD patch pattern.

conceptCards.title: Readable patterns: options objects and named parameters
conceptCards.summary: Single options arg with destructured defaults — forward-compatible public APIs like fetch(url, { signal }).
